From 8844f467d6a58dc915f241e81c46e0c126f8c070 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Dmitry Baryshkov <dmitry.baryshkov@linaro.org>
Date: Sat, 30 Mar 2024 05:53:22 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] drm/msm/dpu: make error messages at
 dpu_core_irq_register_callback() more sensible

There is little point in using %ps to print a value known to be NULL. On
the other hand it makes sense to print the callback symbol in the
'invalid IRQ' message. Correct those two error messages to make more
sense.

Fixes: 6893199183f8 ("drm/msm/dpu: stop using raw IRQ indices in the kernel output")
Signed-off-by: Dmitry Baryshkov <dmitry.baryshkov@linaro.org>
Reviewed-by: Marijn Suijten <marijn.suijten@somainline.org>
Reviewed-by: Abhinav Kumar <quic_abhinavk@quicinc.com>
Patchwork: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/585565/
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240330-dpu-irq-messages-v1-1-9ce782ae35f9@linaro.org
Signed-off-by: Abhinav Kumar <quic_abhinavk@quicinc.com>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/msm/disp/dpu1/dpu_hw_interrupts.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/msm/disp/dpu1/dpu_hw_interrupts.c
index 946dd0135dff..6a0a74832fb6 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/msm/disp/dpu1/dpu_hw_interrupts.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/msm/disp/dpu1/dpu_hw_interrupts.c
@@ -525,14 +525,14 @@ int dpu_core_irq_register_callback(struct dpu_kms *dpu_kms,
 	int ret;
 
 	if (!irq_cb) {
-		DPU_ERROR("invalid IRQ=[%d, %d] irq_cb:%ps\n",
-			  DPU_IRQ_REG(irq_idx), DPU_IRQ_BIT(irq_idx), irq_cb);
+		DPU_ERROR("IRQ=[%d, %d] NULL callback\n",
+			  DPU_IRQ_REG(irq_idx), DPU_IRQ_BIT(irq_idx));
 		return -EINVAL;
 	}
 
 	if (!dpu_core_irq_is_valid(irq_idx)) {
-		DPU_ERROR("invalid IRQ=[%d, %d]\n",
-			  DPU_IRQ_REG(irq_idx), DPU_IRQ_BIT(irq_idx));
+		DPU_ERROR("invalid IRQ=[%d, %d] irq_cb:%ps\n",
+			  DPU_IRQ_REG(irq_idx), DPU_IRQ_BIT(irq_idx), irq_cb);
 		return -EINVAL;
 	}
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/msm/disp/dpu1/dpu_hw_interrupts.c`**
   - The error message for a NULL callback in the `dpu_core_irq_register_callback` function was modified:
     - **Before:** 
       ```c
       DPU_ERROR("invalid IRQ=[%d, %d] irq_cb:%ps\n",
                 DPU_IRQ_REG(irq_idx), DPU_IRQ_BIT(irq_idx), irq_cb);
       ```
     - **After:** 
       ```c
       DPU_ERROR("IRQ=[%d, %d] NULL callback\n",
                 DPU_IRQ_REG(irq_idx), DPU_IRQ_BIT(irq_idx));
       ```
   - The error message for an invalid IRQ was also modified:
     - **Before:** 
       ```c
       DPU_ERROR("invalid IRQ=[%d, %d]\n",
                 DPU_IRQ_REG(irq_idx), DPU_IRQ_BIT(irq_idx));
       ```
     - **After:** 
       ```c
       DPU_ERROR("invalid IRQ=[%d, %d] irq_cb:%ps\n",
                 DPU_IRQ_REG(irq_idx), DPU_IRQ_BIT(irq_idx), irq_cb);
       ```

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications made in the patch improve the clarity and relevance of error messages in the `dpu_core_irq_register_callback` function. The first change removes the printing of a NULL callback pointer when the callback is indeed NULL, which is unnecessary and could be misleading. The second change adds the callback symbol to the error message when an invalid IRQ is detected, providing more context for debugging. Overall, these changes enhance the error reporting mechanism by ensuring that the messages are more informative and logically consistent with the conditions being checked.

```c
          DPU_IRQ_REG(irq_idx), DPU_IRQ_BIT(irq_idx));
```
```c
DPU_ERROR("invalid IRQ=[%d, %d] irq_cb:%ps\n",
          DPU_IRQ_REG(irq_idx), DPU_IRQ_BIT(irq_idx), irq_cb);
```
Reason:
The patch corrects the error messages to provide clearer information. When the callback is NULL, it now explicitly states that the callback is NULL, rather than mixing it with IRQ information. Conversely, when the IRQ is invalid, it includes the callback symbol, which helps in understanding the context of the error. This improves the clarity of the error messages, making it easier to diagnose issues effectively.
